Specification: This specification models a very small state machine with two variables, x and y. The initial state constrains x to be one of the integers 1 through 5 and initializes y as a function from the set {1,2,3,4,5} to 0. The next-state action updates y using the helper operator Foo, which changes entry x to 42 when x = 1 and otherwise leaves the function unchanged, while x itself never changes; the temporal specification asserts Init and that all steps satisfy [][Next]_<<x,y>>, with no explicit fault model, fairness, or additional liveness properties.
CaseExpr: CASE x = 1 -> [ rcds EXCEPT ![x] = 42 ] [] OTHER -> rcds
